# The yellow mug on the windowsill

The first thing Rowan remembers about moving out is a chipped yellow mug. On 7 September 2019, Rowan moved from the parents’ flat to a room above a bakery in Bellwick. A school friend carried the books up two flights. There was no table yet, so they put the mug on the windowsill. A post from two days later describes the smell of warm flour before Rowan woke.[^1]

Looking back in 2026, Rowan is clear that the unfamiliar first evening was not regret about moving. Having a key to the room felt good; what was missing was the kitchen radio from home. The school friend had left by then, but sent a photo of an empty bookshelf and joked that their arms were enjoying retirement.[^2]

## A table, then a desk

On 21 September 2019, Rowan wrote that the school friend had returned with a folding table borrowed from their aunt. They ate noodles from a saucepan, and the yellow mug stood in the middle holding paper flowers Mum had posted. The table was a loan, not Rowan’s to keep; the school friend said their aunt would want it back in winter.[^3]

Rowan handed the table back to the school friend on 19 December 2019, the day before a train trip. The friend took it back to their aunt. By the post of 12 January 2020, a small secondhand desk fitted beneath the window. The paper flowers had faded but stayed in the yellow mug, and Rowan wrote, “I like the room better in the morning than at night.”[^4]

[^1]: Rowan’s [moving-day recollection](Sources/Selected%20excerpts.md#moving-day-recollection), [9 September post](Sources/Selected%20excerpts.md#at-the-bakery-window), and [later date correction](Sources/Selected%20excerpts.md#date-correction). The corrected date comes from a calendar entry quoted by Rowan; the calendar itself was not inspected.
[^2]: Rowan’s [first-evening recollection](Sources/Selected%20excerpts.md#first-evening-recollection), narrated on 2026-11-06. The original message from the school friend was not supplied.
[^3]: Rowan’s [21 September post](Sources/Selected%20excerpts.md#a-table-at-last).
[^4]: Rowan’s [12 January post](Sources/Selected%20excerpts.md#the-window-in-winter) and [later date correction](Sources/Selected%20excerpts.md#date-correction). The date of the friend’s onward handover and the desk’s acquisition date remain unspecified.
